answer: Diverge-or-Die Challenge. Each new identity must answer a fresh random challenge derived from a shared public terrace of seed values, and its reply is checked against its own prior signed outputs. Clones share identical internal state, so they cannot answer divergent challenges independently; any fork produces conflicting replies. On each challenge cycle, the agent must post a pulse of freshly signed commitments before seeing the next seed. Passing costs the attacker a full re-derivation per identity per epoch, and a single contradiction forfeits the relic bond tied to that identity.
